_about: The single source of the Cloudflare deployment's own values. Nothing here changes the page: tools/make_dist.py reads it to write dist/ (the folder Workers Static Assets serves), _headers, _redirects and the github.io redirect stub. The AI proxy address is NOT repeated here: it is site.config.json ai_proxy_url (the page reads it too). The owner types a value here only to change the address or the runtime source.
_aliases_about: Old addresses that stay valid: the github.io project path redirects to site_url (deploy/gh-pages-stub), _redirects maps the old project path on the new host, and the worker keeps the old ORIGIN in ALLOWED_ORIGIN for 30 days (the longest share link lives 30 days). Remove an alias here, regenerate, and it is gone.

runtime._mode_about: self: Pyodide is served from this site (deploy/pyodide-pins.json, tools/fetch_pyodide.py). jsdelivr: the source build's behaviour (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v0.27.7/full/), no rewrite, CSP allows that origin for the engine worker only.

headers._csp_report_only_about: true sends Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only instead (the plan's staging week). The enforced policy is the same text.
headers._unsafe_eval_about: Leave false. Set true ONLY if the Playwright CSP check (tools/check_dist_csp.mjs) shows Pyodide's own glue needs eval; it adds 'unsafe-eval' to /engine/worker.js's policy alone, never to a page.
headers._hsts_about: Leave includeSubDomains false: nothing lives below this host. NEVER set it if the site ever moves to the apex halosyncs.com, because that would cover www (Vercel) and api (StyleCast).
